transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you tell me what brings you in today?

I guess I'm just... having a hard time lately. Um. Most days it feels like I'm just sitting at the bottom of this dark hole. And... I don't know, even when I'm around people I know, I just can't seem to shake this really heavy, hopeless feeling. So... yeah. That's why I'm here.
How long have you been feeling this way?

I don't know... a while, I guess. Um. Maybe... maybe about a year and two months. It started... it was after a fall I had at work. I do HVAC stuff, and I hurt my back pretty bad. Just... everything kind of went downhill from there.
Have you noticed that you don't enjoy things as much as you used to, or that it's hard to get interested in activities you once liked?

Yeah... I guess so. I used to do a lot of stuff. Hiking... painting. I liked tinkering at the makerspace, or even just... figuring out a tricky install for work. 

But... I don't do any of that now. I just kind of... stare at the supplies. People call and I just ignore it. It just... none of it really feels worth starting anymore.
Have you found yourself feeling like you’re not worth much or feeling guilty about things more than usual?

Um... yeah, I guess. I mean... I can't really do the job anymore, so... it's hard not to feel pretty useless. 

I just... I think about the guys I was training, the apprentices. I let them down. And the bills just pile up. It's like... I just sit there thinking about all of it, and it just feels like I messed everything up.
Have you been feeling down or depressed most of the day, nearly every day?

Yeah... most days. I guess that's why I came in. 

It just... I don't know. Most days I feel like I'm sitting at the bottom of a dark hole. Even if I'm around people I know, I just... I can't shake it. It's just this really heavy... hopeless feeling.
Have you noticed that you're feeling really tired or like you don't have any energy lately, most days?
No... I haven't really noticed that. I mean... I'm not really doing enough to get tired, I guess. So, no.
Have you noticed any changes in your appetite or weight recently, like eating a lot more or a lot less than usual?

Um... I guess my eating is kind of all over the place. 

I don't really... I mean, I'll go most of the day just having coffee. Food kind of turns my stomach lately. But then... at night, I'll just pick at whatever's in the cabinet. I don't even really taste it. So... yeah, it's changed, I suppose.
Have you noticed yourself moving or speaking more slowly than usual, or on the flip side, feeling restless or fidgety lately?

I guess... yeah, maybe a little. 

People have been asking if I'm okay. They say I'm... moving like I'm underwater or something. It just takes me longer to do things. Like... just walking from the couch to the kitchen. Or even just answering a question. It's just... slow.
Have you noticed yourself moving or speaking more slowly than usual, or on the flip side, feeling restless or fidgety lately?
Um... you just asked me that. I... I already told you about the moving slow part. I don't know about being restless, though. Not really.
Have you had any thoughts about ending your life or that life isn't worth living?

I... I don't really like talking about this. 

But... yeah. Sometimes I just think everyone would be better off if I didn't wake up. When things just keep piling up—the pain, the money worries... I catch myself thinking about... ending it. It scares me, though, when my mind goes there. I just... I try not to think about it.
Have you found that you don’t take pleasure in anything, or that nothing really feels enjoyable anymore?

Yeah... I suppose. I don't really do much anymore. 

I used to like things. Hiking, or... painting. Going down to the makerspace to tinker with stuff. Even at work, figuring out a tricky install used to be... satisfying, I guess. 

But now... I don't know. I just stare at my supplies and leave them sitting there. People call and I just ignore the phone. Nothing really feels... worth starting.
Have you ever felt this way before, like this kind of depression, or is this the first time you've experienced something like this?
No... I don't think so. I mean, I've had bad days before, but... not like this. This is... it's just heavy. I don't remember it ever being this bad.
Have you ever had a period of time before this one where you felt down or lost interest in things, even if it wasn’t as bad or didn’t last as long?
I mean... no. Not really. Just normal stress, I guess. Nothing where I just... stopped caring about everything.
Have you ever had an episode before this one where you felt down most of the day, lost interest in things, or experienced similar symptoms for at least two weeks?
No. Like I said, just... nothing like this. Never for weeks at a time.
